_doc: Cross-impl turn-compiler parity. Oracle = the REAL compile_codex_turn / compile_cursor_turn, driven over a temp copy of `seed_library` with the wall clock FROZEN to frozen_clock so recency is deterministic. codex `brief` is TurnBrief.to_dict() with the resolved top-level cwd swapped back to the logical input string (the only env-bound field; repo.root/remote are null for the synthetic non-git cwd) -- the TS mirror passes the same cwd and applies the identical swap. BriefItem.score is round(.,1); recognition_confidence is the shared tier-only bucket. The pinned codex_cwd_hit item folds cwd-hit (25) + recency (15) + a NAME_SUBSTRING prompt tier into one session item. cursor briefs drop the runtime compile_latency_us; matched_entities[].score is round(.,2). codex DROPS recency-only non-vague candidates (observe), cursor INCLUDES score>0 recency matches but still buckets confidence 'none' without a name/alias tier hit.
